### Findings checked and refused

- Unit 22 i, ጠፋልሐ left as the Geʿez word with (?): inventing a measure would be worse than showing the unknown word; the note says it cannot be identified.
- Units 32 and 34 i, “go in to” / “went in to her”: literal for ባእ ኀበ / ቦአ ኀቤሃ, and the note explains it as a euphemism; kept.
- Unit 32 i, “through her” for በውስቴታ ‘in her’: acceptable sense for the context; kept.
- Unit 36 i, “grown up before her own son”: matches l and the note’s literal ‘from before’; the sense (older than) is not certain, left as is.
- Unit 34 i, “bore a son”: the object -ቶ ‘him’ in ወሰመየቶ supports it; kept.
- Unit 14 i/l and unit 15: ምስር and ግብጽ renderings match known-forms; no change.
- Cross-references “unit N” in notes (0, 6, 11, 13, 14, 15, 36): all point to the correct units under 0-based numbering; kept. If the site numbers units from 1, they would all be off by one; this should be settled at build.
- Unit 20 i, አኀው “siblings”: the plural of አኅ ‘brother’ used for a brother and sister is a reasonable reading and the note says so.
